title: The Sharp Scholars of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sanhedrin 17b they said that Ayfa and Avimi, sons of Rechava, are the sharp scholars of Pumbedita; and they are mentioned in Kiddushin 39b and Menachot 17a under the anonymous designation "the sharp scholars of Pumbedita," and Rashi explained [that this means] Ayfa and Avimi, sons of Rechava.
